title: Godot 4.6.2 stable crashes with an access violation when running a minimal project in headless mode with `--quit` on Windows
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot version: `4.6.2.stable.official.71f334935`
- Engine version from crash output: `Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.official (71f334935c000924d403448e698df4441130df18)`
- OS: `Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26200.0`
- PowerShell: `5.1.26100.7920`
- Install source: Winget package `GodotEngine.GodotEngine`

### System information

OS: `Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26200.0` - PowerShell: `5.1.26100.7920` - Install source: Winget package `GodotEngine.GodotEngine`

### Issue description

Godot 4.6.2 stable crashes with an access violation when running a minimal project in headless mode with `--quit` on Windows. The crash happens while trying to create/open `user://logs`.

This reproduces with both the console executable and GUI executable installed via Winget. It also reproduces when passing `--disable-file-logging` and when passing a custom `--user-data-dir`.

### Steps to reproduce

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create the minimal project below.
2. Run the console executable with:

```powershell
& '<USERPROFILE>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\GodotEngine.GodotEngine_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path '<path-to-minimal-project>' --quit
```

3. Observe the crash.

Additional commands that also reproduce the crash:

```powershell
& '<USERPROFILE>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\GodotEngine.GodotEngine_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --disable-file-logging --path '<path-to-minimal-project>' --quit
```

```powershell
& '<USERPROFILE>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\GodotEngine.GodotEngine_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --user-data-dir '<path-to-custom-user-data>' --path '<path-to-minimal-project>' --quit
```

```powershell
& '<USERPROFILE>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\GodotEngine.GodotEngine_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\Godot_v4.6.2-stable_win64.exe' --headless --path '<path-to-minimal-project>' --quit
```

## Expected Behavior

Godot should initialize the minimal project in headless mode and exit cleanly with `--quit`.

If log creation fails, Godot should report the logging error without crashing.

`--disable-file-logging` should avoid file logging setup or at least avoid this crash path.

## Actual Behavior

Godot crashes with signal 11 / Windows access violation while trying to create `user://logs`.

The failing runs exit with:

```text
-1073741819
```

That corresponds to Windows access violation `0xC0000005`.

Captured stderr from the minimal project:


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

## Minimal Project Used

The repro was run against a temporary minimal project containing only:

`project.godot`

```ini
; Engine configuration file.
; Generated by Codex to reproduce Godot headless logging crash.
config_version=5

[application]
config/name="Godot Headless Repro"
run/main_scene="res://main.tscn"
config/features=PackedStringArray("4.6")
```

`main.tscn`

```text
[gd_scene format=3]

[node name="Main" type="Node2D"]
```
